note: Independently rejudged 2026-10-22; no execution or stamping. RFC 7950 Section 8.3.3: "If the datastore is "running" or "startup", these constraints MUST be enforced at the end of the <edit-config> or <copy-config> operation." Section 8.1 includes the complete obligations "Nodes MUST be present for at most one case branch in all choices.", "There MUST be no nodes tagged with "when" present if the "when" condition evaluates to "false" in the data tree.", and "All "unique" constraints on lists MUST be satisfied." This gap row has no tagged tests. Read internal/component/config/loader.go::LoadConfig/refuseInvalidCustomSections, config/validate_sections.go::ValidateCustomSections and referenceFailures, cli/validator.go::sectionErrors and cli/editor_commit.go::validateStagedTree. Load/validation/editor surfaces reach the shared boundary; referenceFailures walks ToPluginMap and the SSH editor retains BGP reference failures. The new original-tree validator registered in bgp/config/register.go and implemented by redistribution.go::validateFilterPolicies/parsePolicyDisposition rejects malformed explicit policy layers, but is not general evaluation of when, list unique or choice exclusivity. config/yang/validator.go::walkTree validates supplied values, cardinality and mandatory nodes; validator_mandatory.go::requireMandatoryInPresentCases visits each present case without rejecting multiple cases. The schema still declares unique mac/address and mac/match on interface ethernet and unique mac/address on veth/bridge in internal/component/iface/yang/ze-iface-conf.yang. Thus the existing unmet general constraints remain unmet and the verdict stays unimplemented. Correct an unsupported current-state claim in the prior note: its 174/200 versus 26/200 overlay observation is historical, not evidence of present nondeterministic default-reference acceptance. Current config/yang/validator_default.go::activeBranch counts present branches and CaseInEffect explicitly returns false when holding > 1, so no conflicting-case default is in effect. That correction does not enforce choice exclusivity itself: it withholds defaults, rather than refusing the conflicting data tree. Preserve the declared gap and do not claim any new test, overlay or conformance credit.
